pages.description: Mushara Bush Camp offers a down-to-earth tented bush experience on the doorstep of the famous Etosha National Park in Namiba.
pages.text:
Mushara Bush Camp - The Mushara Collection
The Mushara Collection
Mushara Bush Camp
Mushara Bush Camp offers a down-to-earth tented bush experience
Mushara Bush Camp is ideally suited as an exceptionally affordable base for independent travellers and families exploring the wonders of Etosha National Park
The Bush Camp accommodates 32 guest and 8 children in custom made tent like structures. The Mushara Bush Camp offers a down-to-earth tented bush camp experience which is well suited as an exceptional affordable base for independent travelers and families exploring the magical Etosha Pan National Park.
The main Bush Camp House is thatched and has a true bush camp feel to it. The early evenings see a campfire lit where guest can exchange stories of the day’s wildlife sightings. Dinner, lunch and breakfast are served on the thatched verandah with the bush being a mere step away.
Rack Rates
Each of the 16 custom made en-suite tents is built from canvas, wood and local limestone
With an 8 m2 private veranda and windows from floor to ceiling, these tents are spacious and airy. Four of them have a sleeper couch suitable for two children each. The large bathroom has a big window and the shower offers views into the surrounding bush. The brushed cement floors and stone walls keep the tents cool even in the afternoon sun. A coffee station, safe deposit box, mosquito net, socket for charging storage batteries, hair drier and floor fan are standard. Whether you enjoy the privacy of your veranda or the comfort of your tent, the tranquility of the bush is guaranteed.
Wifi is available in the common area/main lodge area.
We will make your children feel welcome at Mushara Bush Camp
Children are very welcome to bring their parents along to Mushara Bush Camp. The main house features a special play area for children. Books, games, toys, drawing utensils, creative games and very friendly child minders keep your children busy.
The play park outside sports a jungle gym, an old tractor and a sand pit. And of course there is also a kiddies’ pool.Meal times and meals will be arranged according to the children’s needs.
What to experience at Mushara Bush Camp
Mushara Cuisine
Mushara is proud to serve delectable homemade meals incorporating a significant amount of their own vegetables, herbs, and fruit from the Mushara garden.
The Bush Camp Pool
After a long fruitful day on safari, our very friendly child minders can entertain your kids whilst you relax on the verandah and they play in the sparkling kiddies’ pool.
Game Drives
Mushara’s experienced and enthusiastic guides will embellish you with their intricate knowledge of the Etosha pan, the flora and fauna and the diverse animal species you will encounter.

The Mushara Bush Camp is your optimal family destination on the doorstep to the magical Etosha National Park

Amazing Family Tents & Superb Food!
Close to Etosha s Von Lindequist gate, Mushara Bush Camp is fantastic in all categories. The family tents are large and well equipped there isn t anything they haven t thought of. The food is large city restaurant quality very unexpected. The grounds are beautiful and full of birds and small wildlife. Our only regret is not having time to stay additional nights.
Adrienne, Guest at Mushara Bush Camp
Stunning!
It’s the service that blows you away so concerned, interested, charming. Food is spectacular especially the braii. Tents are superbly equipped. Friendly wart hogs and mongoose wander around. Nice pool. Just 10kms from the east gate to Etosha.
HofH999, Guest at Mushara Bush Camp
Pampered in the wilderness
Just an incredible stay. The staff ensured that we were well taken care of and were there to make sure we didn t have to worry our think about anything. Good was top notch gourmet. The tents are nestled together in the bush, at the same time as offering privacy. We ended up doing a safari and were so lucky to see all the animals we saw! The guide was excellent.
Derrick, Guest at Mushara Bush Camp
Our favourite camp in Namibia
We absolutely loved Mushara Bush camp. Our rooms were amazing. Staff were very friendly. Wildlife was incredible. We saw absolutely everything! Just wish we could have stayed longer. Food delicious too! You even get your laundry done for you!
Thanks so much, we will be back.
Rosalund , Guest at Mushara Bush Camp

Mushara Lodge - The Mushara Collection
The Mushara Collection
Mushara Lodge
Mushara Lodge is the original establishment in the collection – the elegant lady
Located just 8 km from the Von Lindequist Gate on the eastern boundary of Etosha National Park, Mushara Lodge is an ideal overnight stop for visitors to the game reserve
The lodge consists of ten spacious chalets, one family unit and a triple room. The name Mushara is derived from the Purple Pod Terminalia tree which grows abundantly on the lodge grounds and in the surroundings. The thatched public area includes a small library with a selection of good books, a bar with an extensive wine cellar, an airy lounge complete with welcoming fireplace for winter evenings, a dining area and a well stocked curio shop.
Great attention has been paid to the décor, which is an eclectic blend of traditional African and modern works of art mixed with original older paintings.
Rack Rates
Ten well-spaced thatched chalets are arranged in a horseshoe shape around the swimming pool
All the chalets and individual rooms are extremely spacious and equipped with air-conditioning, mosquito net, mini-bar, safe, tea and coffee station, sockets for charging storage batteries and direct telephone connection.
The bathrooms are en-suite with separate toilette. The chalets and single rooms have a shower, whereas the triple room and the family house have a shower and bath.
Wifi is available at rooms/tents and common areas.
What to experience at Mushara Lodge
Mushara Cuisine
Mushara is proud to serve delectable homemade meals incorporating a significant amount of their own vegetables, herbs, and fruit from the Mushara garden.
Mushara Pool
In the heat of the Namibian day, guests can wallow and swim in the invigorating large blue swimming pool, surrounded by green lawns which are kept perfectly manicured by visiting local wildlife.
Game Drives
Mushara’s experienced and enthusiastic guides will embellish you with their intricate knowledge of the Etosha pan, the flora and fauna and the diverse animal species you will encounter.

Luxury in wilderness!
Mushara Lodge is a high quality lodge near by Etosha NP. We experienced a very warm welcome by the staff especially Bernadette was very helpfull and kind. Definitely the best staff, food and room during our trip through Namibia. Thanks a lot for everything! We will return as soon as possible!
Alena, Guest at Mushara Lodge
A Namibian gem
A luxurious lodge on the outskirts of Etosha National Park that is a truly epic place to stay. Amazing and friendly staff excellent lunch, dinner, and breakfast, wonderful and insightful game drive and a perfect room and swimming pool area. Couldn t ask for anymore. We wish we could have stayed longer than two nights!
BiggySmiles, Guest at Mushara Lodge
A lodge with real wow factor!
Just wow! Such a treat to stay here. Everything from the accommodation the food the grounds all exceeded our expectations! The staff were so friendly and as a bonus they took us onto a neighbouring farm to get up close to three lioness’s. Cannot recommend highly enough.
Nick, Guest at Mushara Lodge
Can’t rate highly enough!
This is my all time favourite lodge. Great staff, perfect location for the park, excellent food and large comfortable chalets. The communal areas have a nostalgic air of understated luxury. Absolutely stunning lodge. This was our second visit and it won’t be our last!
GJen, Guest at Mushara Lodge

Villa Mushara - The Mushara Collection
The Mushara Collection
Villa Mushara
Villa Mushara is a place that will leave you yearning for more, long after your departure
Villa Mushara is situated a mere 8 kilometers from the Von Lindequist gate of the world famous Etosha National Park, thus allowing the best of both worlds
The rugged harsh wilderness of Etosha combined with the exquisite accommodation and cuisine of Villa Mushara offers a stark contrast, which has been depicted in the villas through the use of opposing textures. With individuality in mind, only two exclusive villas have been designed to create an ideal retreat from the stress of modern day life, where an aura of tranquility and contemplation prevails.
Rack Rates
Each villa has its own unique ambience, designed with a classic appeal
Each fine detail has been considered within the confines of the 140 square metre living space, from a small private library in each villa to a silver candle snuff in the en suite bathroom.
Air-conditioning will moderate the outside climate and the mini bar with its comprehensive selection of beverages, will satisfy even the most discerning palates. If music is required, an interesting selection of CDs ranging from Mozart to Santana will provide the ideal mood.
What to experience at Villa Mushara
Mushara Cuisine
Mushara is proud to serve delectable homemade meals incorporating a significant amount of their own vegetables, herbs, and fruit from the Mushara garden.
Villa Mushara
Africa’s sweltering sun and desert destinations don’t need to leave you feeling flustered. Soothe away the scorch in the cool welcoming waters of your own private plunge pool with loungers to relax in.
Game Drives
Mushara’s experienced and enthusiastic guides will embellish you with their intricate knowledge of the Etosha pan, the flora and fauna and the diverse animal species you will encounter.
Make an Enquiry
Book now
Timeless appeal, shrouded by Etosha’s eminent mystique. Experience the best of both worlds. Whether its your memories of relaxing in the private plunge pool or lounging in the “sala” that’s immersed in bush.

Wow!
Probably one of the best hotel experiences we’ve had. We had a villa total bliss. Good location for Etosha National Park. Staff were the best we experienced in Namibia. Only regret we only had one night here could have stayed for a lifetime.
fromleeds , Guest at Villa Mushara
Luxury in the bush!
Our villa at Mushara Lodge was spacious and comfortable. We loved the fireplace, pool, and large bathtub. Meals at the lodge were delicious and the staff were very helpful. Would have loved to stay here for a few more days.
jonesem92, Guest at Villa Mushara
Wonderful!
We are just back from a 7 night stay at this beautiful little hidden gem , set deep in the African bush and we loved it so much, we’ve booked another 10 night stay this month. So tastefully decorated, you will literally want to take everything inside the villa home with you.
Clare, Guest at Villa Mushara
The dream of Namibia
Rented two of the villas. There was absolutely nothing left to be desired. Perfect choice of in-house music, decor and amenities. Watering hole outside, a small dipping pool, great dining and close to Etosha national park.
Ales, Guest at Villa Mushara

A Brief History of Mushara - The Mushara Collection
The Mushara Collection
Luxury accommodation on the outskirts of Etosha National Park
Mushara offers luxury accommodation on the doorstep of the famous Etosha National Park, located just 8 km from the Von Lindequist gate of the reserve.
The Mushara Collection is an oasis of hospitality and bespoke service, where the staff are the Spirit behind the brand.
Etosha National Park
The park covers an area of 22,270 km² and is home to dozens of mammal and reptile species, several amphibian species, more than 300 bird species and even one species of fish.
